analysis:
Examined all five changed files and found no concrete security regression.

1. EngineV2Factory+Production.swift: ProductionBuild gains a `prefillGeometry` field (lines 115-117, 137-138, 152, 401-402). It is built from the scheduler config handed to the engine. It is metadata only and does not touch prefix-cache keys, scoping, TTL, SSD paths or admission/memory-owner logic. T-041 stays the same in kind (HMAC names, cacheSalt, TTL). No change to cache gating or at-rest artifacts.

2. FlintResponseFormat.swift line 114: the `.toolCallDelta` event case is added to the ignore branch of the exhaustive switch. Streamed tool-call fragments are not added to the validated content. This matches the existing behaviour for `.toolCall`, and the guide says a request with both tools and a response_format gets only the response format. The validate step is unchanged and still fails closed.

3. ProviderLoop+SSEParser.swift: `toolCallsDelta` and `encodeToolCallsForHash` now use `OpenAIToolCallDelta`. The encoding is the same, with one marker per fragment and U+001F delimiters. The comment says complete calls encode as before, but I could not see the `OpenAIToolCallDelta` definition, so I could not confirm that. The response-hash domain for streamed tool calls could differ from what the coordinator or consumer expects. This is an integration and integrity-consistency question for T-007/T-008, not a demonstrated vulnerability. The hash is also not consumer-verifiable, so there is no new trust boundary.

4. LaunchAgent.swift (lines 265-269, 289-290; unit 72a619a12f7f3e12:0 has no text, only the patch excerpt): two non-secret CBv2 tuning env keys (`prefillChunkKey`, `stepTokenBudgetKey`) are added to the launchd passthrough allowlist. They are operator-set performance knobs that are numeric and not credentials. An operator already controls their own provider process (TB-003), so there is no new privilege boundary. A very large value could affect provider availability, but that is self-inflicted. Whether the factory bounds the values is outside the supplied evidence.

Remaining unverified: the `OpenAIToolCallDelta` encoding and hash compatibility, and the bounds on the new env parsing in EngineV2Factory.
